approval_statement: Ingest the reviewed 2025-26 exposure into the approved live database in the established 2024-25 analytical shape, keep the seasons isolated, add clearly labelled temporary league-mean placeholders for Benetton and Edinburgh, and carry the reviewed result through the existing 2025-26 dashboard release path.
conditions: The exact candidate, manifests, decisions and privacy boundary must pass revalidation.
A fresh independent review must pass before live mutation.
The approved Supabase/Postgres target must be proved immediately before every database query or write.
Benetton and Edinburgh estimates must remain reporting overlays and never source evidence.
No 2024-25 data or released payload may drift.
